title: How to Whitelist and Allow 3rd Party iFrames to be embedded within the Froala Text Editor | Brilliant Directories Documentation | BD Support
content: How to Whitelist and Allow 3rd Party iFrames to be embedded within the Froala Text Editor Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000072585 By default, the platform supports iframes from Youtube, Vimeo, Facebook, and SoundCloud. The rest of the platforms that provide sharable content through iframes are blocked, for security purposes, by the platform. The way to bypass this is by adding a comma-separated list of URLs that provide the iframe content, to the advance setting: Allowed Iframe Sources System Variable: iframe_source_whitelist Once the URL of the website providing the iframe has been added, the content should immediately show up once the iframe is shared on the site. Important : sharing content through iframes should be supported by any froala editor of the site.
